name: Acmmm2025_video_benchmark
description: Acmmm2025_video_benchmark is a video understanding benchmark designed to evaluate models on core video tasks such as classification, action recognition, temporal localization, and retrieval across diverse video clips. It measures models' ability to interpret dynamic visual content, temporal structure, and scene-level semantics using standardized splits and annotations. The benchmark is intended for comparative evaluation of video and multimodal architectures in the lead-up to ACM MM 2025.
general_score_metric: mAP (primary for detection/retrieval tasks); accuracy for classification
reputation: New/contest-style benchmark associated with ACM Multimedia 2025; limited adoption so far but intended for community evaluation.
